description: Create a vendor credit. Accepts vendor/account/department names (will lookup IDs automatically). Lines represent credit amounts applied to expense accounts. Returns credit details and a link to view in QuickBooks.

ap_account.description: Accounts Payable account name or number (optional, defaults to standard AP). Only Accounts Payable-type accounts are matched.

department_id.description: Header-level department/location ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use department_name)

department_name.description: Header-level department/location name (e.g., '20358', 'Cotati'). Will be looked up to get ID.

doc_number.description: Reference number for the vendor credit (optional)

draft.description: If true, validate and show preview without creating (default: true)

lines.description: Array of line items. Each line credits an expense account.

account_id.description: Account ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use account_name)

account_name.description: Account name or number (e.g., '5000 Cost of Goods Sold'). Will be looked up to get ID.

customer_id.description: Customer ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use customer_name)

customer_name.description: Customer or project this line is attributed to (auto-resolved to ID). Sets AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail.CustomerRef. Vendor credit lines accept a customer only — the vendor is the header vendor_name. The line is marked NotBillable.

memo.description: Private memo for the vendor credit

vendor_id.description: Vendor ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use vendor_name)

vendor_name.description: Vendor display name (e.g., 'Acme Corp'). Will be looked up to get ID.

name: create_vendor_credit
